# PageSizeToken

<!-- Generated from the doc comments in the library. Do not edit this file. -->

The name of a standard page size, such as `'a4'`, `'letter'` or `'legal'`; matches the sizes on [`PdfSize`](pdf-size.md).

Import from `@bonniepdf/core`.

```typescript
type PageSizeToken = 'a0' | 'a1' | 'a2' | 'a3' | 'a4' | 'a5' | 'b0' | 'b1' | 'b2' | 'b3' | 'b4' | 'b5' | 'letter' | 'legal' | 'tabloid' | 'ledger' | 'statement' | 'executive'
```
